hook: She fell 300 feet off an Oregon sea cliff
narration: This German shepherd fell three hundred feet off an Oregon cliff.
She was hurt on a secluded beach, reachable only by rappelling down the cliff or by air.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from Astoria lowered their rescue swimmer to the rocks.
He waded through the surf on the rocks to reach her.
Crews lift a hurt dog in a rescue basket, a metal cage it can lie down inside.
Then the basket came up, with her inside.
outcome: The Astoria crew lifted her out and handed her over on dry land.
title: German shepherd fell 300 feet
description:
A Coast Guard aircrew from Air Station Astoria hoisted a German shepherd that fell 300 feet from a cliff onto a secluded beach in Ecola State Park, Cannon Beach, Oregon, June 14, 2023.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Diolanda Caballero, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/887236/coast-guard-air-station-astoria-rescues-german-shepard-ecola-beach
